The '''Hunter''' was a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] model produced by [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Hunter was first introduced in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
